title: A card from Jimmy
evenTitle: He says he ... She says she ... They say they ...

words.zh: 写（过去式 wrote，过去分词 written）

lines.speaker: Grandmother
lines.en: Read Jimmy's card to me please, Penny.
lines.zh: 请把吉米的明信片念给我听听，彭妮。

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: 'I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.'
lines.zh: “我刚到苏格兰，我现在住在一家青年招待所。”

lines.speaker: Grandmother
lines.en: Eh?

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: He says he's just arrived in Scotland.

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
lines.zh: 他说他现在住在一家青年招待所。

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: You know he's a member of the Y.H.A.
lines.zh: 您知道，他是“青招协”的一个成员。

lines.speaker: Grandmother
lines.en: The what?

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: The Y.H.A., Mum.

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: The Youth Hostels Association.

lines.speaker: Grandmother
lines.en: What else does he say?

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: 'I'll write a letter soon.

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: I hope you are all well.'

lines.speaker: Grandmother
lines.en: What?

lines.speaker: Grandmother
lines.en: Speak up, Penny.

lines.speaker: Grandmother
lines.en: I'm afraid I can't hear you.

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: He says he'll write a letter soon.

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: He hopes we are all well.

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: 'Love, Jimmy.'

lines.speaker: Grandmother
lines.en: Is that all?

lines.speaker: Grandmother
lines.en: He doesn't say very much, does he?

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: He can't write very much on a card, Mum.
lines.zh: 在明信片上他写不了很多，妈妈。

drills.en: He says he ___ just arrived in Scotland.

drills.zh: 他们说他们需要一些钱。

drills.en: He says he ___ a letter soon.
He says he has ___ his milk.
drills.zh: 他说他已经把牛奶喝完了。

drills.en: He doesn't say very much, ___ he?
He says he ___ wait for a bus.
drills.zh: 他说他必须等公共汽车。
